name: claude-skills
description: Small, composable Claude Code plugins: a one-command interview-plan-execute-review pipeline, an adversarial five-advisor council, vendored engineering-discipline skills, a game save-file reverse-engineering method, and an output style that strips the padding out of replies.

plugins.name: patimakorn
plugins.description: One command for a large piece of work. Run it as `/patimakorn:anvil <what you want built>`. It interviews you as a design tree, writes a plan into the repo, orients and researches through workflow scripts that answer every repository question with a read-only subagent and every outside question with a fetch-budgeted one at sonnet, then hands the plan to a second script that runs every task on its own executor subagent and starts each one the moment its own blockers land, so delegation is what the code does rather than what the prose asks for. It commits each task separately so any one can be reverted alone, re-runs every task's verify itself rather than trusting the executor's report, loops the review until it comes back clean, and then asks you one question before marking the plan done: is this what you asked for. The interview argues with the decisions you arrived holding, and writes the ones that outlive the plan out as ADRs so they survive the worklist. Run it with no arguments to resume an in-progress plan after a session ends.

plugins.name: engineering-kit
plugins.description: Nine model-invoked engineering disciplines the agent reaches for on its own: diagnosing-bugs, tdd, prototype, research, domain-modeling, codebase-design, resolving-merge-conflicts, wizard, writing-for-agents. Pairs with the patimakorn plugin, which uses them when they are installed. Derived from Matt Pocock's skills repository under MIT - see the plugin's NOTICE.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: An output style that strips the padding out of Claude's replies. No "I'll now", no apology, no restating your question - one fact per line, numbers instead of adjectives. Code, commands, paths and error text stay byte-exact, and so does anything written to disk. Install, then pick caveman:Caveman in /config — plugin output styles are namespaced, and the picker moved out of /output-style.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Convene five advisors with deliberately opposed lenses (Architect, Skeptic, Pragmatist, Researcher, Contrarian), have them peer-review each other anonymously, force a debate round when the agreement looks like groupthink, and deliver a verdict that preserves the minority view. For decisions that are expensive to reverse.

plugins.name: game-save-re
plugins.description: A method for reverse-engineering and patching game save files: identify the container format, locate the field, re-sign checksums and length prefixes, and verify in-game. Engine-agnostic (Unity, Godot, Ren'Py, RPG Maker, custom binary).
